# Package `rpc`

```go
package rpc
```

Package rpc provides the transport-neutral support used by generated MRPC clients and services.

## Functions

### func CodeOf

```go
func CodeOf(err error) (string, string)
```

CodeOf returns the status code and message carried by err. Unknown errors are reported as internal so callers never need to inspect error strings.

### func NewClient

```go
func NewClient(contract Contract, options ClientOptions) *Client
```

NewClient creates a lazy MRPC client. It performs no host call until the first method invocation.

### func NewError

```go
func NewError(code string, message string) error
```

NewError constructs a status error. An empty code represents success.

### func NewServer

```go
func NewServer(options ServerOptions, contract Contract) (*Server, error)
```

NewServer publishes one exact generated service contract.

### type Client

```go
type Client struct { ... }
```

Client owns one lazily established exact route binding.

#### func Client.Bind

```go
func (c *Client) Bind() error
```

Bind establishes the exact route without invoking a business method. Repeated calls reuse the binding. A failed binding may be retried until Close.

#### func Client.Call

```go
func (c *Client) Call(method Method, receiver *Resource, arguments []Value) ([]Value, error)
```

Call invokes one method using canonical values generated from typed source.

#### func Client.CallOwned

```go
func (c *Client) CallOwned(method Method, receiver *Resource, arguments []Value) (*CallResult, error)
```

CallOwned leaves returned resources pending until typed decoding succeeds.

#### func Client.Close

```go
func (c *Client) Close() error
```

Close closes the exact route binding and all resources owned by it.

#### func Client.DecodeResource

```go
func (c *Client) DecodeResource(value Value, typeHash string) (*Resource, error)
```

DecodeResource validates a pending resource returned to this client.

#### func Client.Reference

```go
func (c *Client) Reference(resource *Resource, typeHash string) (Value, error)
```

Reference checks that a generated handle belongs to this live client.

#### func Client.Release

```go
func (c *Client) Release(resource *Resource) error
```

Release releases one remote resource. Repeated release is harmless.
